title: Aegis
description: A single Rust binary covering black-box DAST, local-source SAST, real-CVE matching, and out-of-band collaboration.

attack-surface-discovery.title: Attack-surface discovery
attack-surface-discovery.description: Crawls same-origin links and forms, parses robots.txt/sitemap.xml, mines JS bundles for API endpoints, and Arjun-style brute-forces hidden parameter names before fuzzing.

40-owasp-mapped-vulnerability-checks.title: 40 OWASP-mapped vulnerability checks
40-owasp-mapped-vulnerability-checks.description: Covers injection (SQLi, NoSQLi, cmdi, SSTI, LDAP/XPath, log4shell), XSS/CSRF/SSRF/IDOR/JWT/GraphQL and more, each finding tagged with a WSTG v4.2 test ID, CWE, and CAPEC ref.

verification-proof-pass.title: Verification & proof pass
verification-proof-pass.description: Grades every finding confirmed/firm/tentative, extracts real proof (DB version via error-based SQLi, an /etc/passwd line for LFI, evaluated SSTI expressions), and emits a replayable curl PoC.

out-of-band-collaborator-listener.title: Out-of-band collaborator listener
out-of-band-collaborator-listener.description: A standalone collaborator binary that catches blind SSRF/stored-XSS callbacks over raw TCP, buckets hits by token, and persists them to a JSONL log.

tree-sitter-rule-engine.title: Tree-sitter rule engine
tree-sitter-rule-engine.description: 11 language-aware queries (SQLi string-concat, command exec/eval, unsafe deserialization, weak crypto, path traversal, SSRF, open redirect, XSS sinks, disabled TLS verification, XPath/LDAP injection, weak PRNGs) across Rust/TS/TSX/JS/Python.

hardcoded-secret-scanner.title: Hardcoded-secret scanner
hardcoded-secret-scanner.description: Regex-based secret detection that lossily decodes non-UTF-8 files so a single invalid byte can't silently disable the rule for the whole file.

self-scan-feedback-loop-guard.title: Self-scan feedback-loop guard
self-scan-feedback-loop-guard.description: Canonicalized-path exclusion so re-running a scan over a tree containing this tool's own prior CVE-record output doesn't re-detect its own evidence text as new secrets.

real-cve-matching-osv-nvd.title: Real-CVE matching (OSV/NVD)
real-cve-matching-osv-nvd.description: Fingerprints component@version from server banners and queries OSV.dev plus optional NVD to attach genuine, matched CVEs instead of guesses.

cve-record-writer.title: CVE-record writer
cve-record-writer.description: Persists every finding as a cvelistV5-shaped JSON record, giving self-discovered issues honest PENTEST-LOCAL IDs rather than fabricating a real-looking CVE number.

standards-mapped-reporting.title: Standards-mapped reporting
standards-mapped-reporting.description: Every finding carries WSTG/CWE/CAPEC refs plus JSON/HTML report output and stable exit codes built for CI gating and agent/script consumption.
